NATIVE_KNOWLEDGE.TITLE: Knowledge
NATIVE_KNOWLEDGE.DESCRIPTION: Reusable FAQs and documents for your agents. Store catalogs are managed in integrations.
NATIVE_KNOWLEDGE.NAME: Name
NATIVE_KNOWLEDGE.UNAVAILABLE: Knowledge is not enabled for this account.

NATIVE_KNOWLEDGE.PREVIEW_LIMIT: Showing the first 20 records. All records have been validated.
NATIVE_KNOWLEDGE.AGENTS_HINT: Reuse this base across account-owned agents. Response behavior and inbox configuration are configured separately.
NATIVE_KNOWLEDGE.EMPTY_AGENTS: No agents use this base yet.
